description: This file defines the DefaultKafkaConfig class, an implementation of KafkaConfig, which manages Kafka producer configuration settings, including parsing and instantiation from a Config object, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

classes.name: DefaultKafkaConfig
classes.description: Immutable class that encapsulates Kafka producer configuration, providing methods for creation, access, and object comparison.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultKafkaConfig instance from a provided Config object, initializing internalConfig for the Kafka producer.

methods.name: getInternalProducerConfig
methods.description: Returns the Kafka producer configuration as a Config object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare DefaultKafkaConfig instances based on their internalProducerConfig.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Provides a hash code based on internalProducerConfig.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including class name and internalProducerConfig details.
